_comment: Home's words and counts. tiles: how many recent-tab tiles show, 'first' on a first visit when there is nothing recent. offline-pin: the tab kept among them while the backend is down. greetings: the first whose 'until' (hour, 24h) is above the hour of day. {n} in a line is filled in by the code.

copy.welcome-resume: One tap to carry on. Everything else is one step away.
copy.welcome-first: Tafheem reads Arabic word by word, with the reason. Start with one small lesson.
copy.placeholder: Type an ayah, a word, @root or a sentence
copy.keys: Press 1 to {n} to jump to a tab.
copy.offline-body: Lessons will not load until the backend is running. Your place is saved on this device.
copy.guest: Keep your progress on every device.
